title: Election Results Certified
summary:
*   City leaders gathered for a special session to officially confirm the outcome of the June 4, 1994 runoff election.
*   The results of the runoff election were formally approved by a 6-0 vote.
*   The meeting was brief, concluding after just 15 minutes.
